Scatter or Dot Rows Coloured by Group

Source: R/figure-plots-groups.R
PlotScatterGroups.Rd

Points coloured by the group of each unit, with optional open symbols for flagged units, labels with offsets in points, lines connecting the points of a unit across conditions (paired values), median bars and categorical axes. A categorical y axis gives one row per unit (dot rows), with tick labels coloured by group, separators between groups and a "not estimable" text where the value is missing.

Usage

PlotScatterGroups(
  data,
  x = "x",
  y = "y",
  group = "group",
  group_colours = NULL,
  id = NULL,
  x_order = NULL,
  x_labels = NULL,
  y_order = NULL,
  y_labels = NULL,
  colour_ticks = TRUE,
  open = NULL,
  size = 20,
  stroke = 0,
  open_stroke = 0.7,
  connect = FALSE,
  linewidth = 0.65,
  line_alpha = 0.85,
  open_linewidth = NULL,
  open_linetype = "32",
  open_shift = NULL,
  open_shift_default = 0,
  summary = FALSE,
  summary_half = 5.9,
  summary_linewidth = 1.4,
  label = NULL,
  label_only = NULL,
  label_first = FALSE,
  label_offset = c(5, 0),
  label_offsets = NULL,
  label_size = 5.3,
  label_vjust = 0.5,
  label_colour = "group",
  missing_text = "NE",
  missing_size = 5.3,
  separators = FALSE,
  x_limits = NULL,
  y_limits = NULL,
  x_breaks = NULL,
  y_breaks = NULL,
  x_nbins = 6,
  y_nbins = 9,
  log_y = FALSE,
  x_label = NULL,
  y_label = NULL,
  grid = c("y", "x", "both", "none"),
  tick_size = NULL,
  title_size = NULL,
  stats = NULL,
  note = NULL,
  note_xy = c(0.97, 0.96),
  note_hjust = 1,
  note_vjust = 1,
  note_size = 4.8,
  note_colour = "muted",
  reference = NULL,
  reference_x = "x",
  reference_group = NULL,
  reference_linewidth = 0.5,
  reference_linetype = "32",
  ties = FALSE,
  tie_dodge = 0.16,
  tie_label_dx = c(0.12, 0.08),
  tie_label_size = 4.3,
  tie_label_colour = "muted",
  box_mm = NULL,
  style = ManuscriptStyle()
)

Arguments

data

Tidy data.

x, y

Columns. Character columns are categorical.

group

Group column.

group_colours

Named colours per group.

id

Unit column (for connections, labels and offsets).

x_order, x_labels

Order and tick labels of a categorical x.

y_order, y_labels

Order (top to bottom) and tick labels of a categorical y; y_labels = FALSE hides them.

colour_ticks

Colour categorical y tick labels by group.

open

Optional logical column: open symbols (and dashed connections) when TRUE.

size

Point area (pt^2).

stroke

Edge width of filled points (pt); open symbols use open_stroke.

open_stroke

Edge of open symbols.

connect

Connect the points of each id across x.

linewidth, line_alpha

Connection style (points).

open_linewidth, open_linetype

Width and dash pattern of connections of open units (default: linewidth, dashed).

open_shift

Horizontal shift of open units (x units); a named list gives shifts per id overriding open_shift_default.

open_shift_default

Shift for open units without an entry.

summary

Draw a median bar per x over units that are not open.

summary_half, summary_linewidth

Half-width (points) and width of median bars.

label

Optional label column; labels of points outside the axes are not drawn.

label_only

Optional logical column: label only these rows.

label_first

Label only the first point (lowest x) of each unit.

label_offset

Default label offset in points (c(dx, dy)).

label_offsets

Named list of offsets per id.

label_size

Label size; label_colour "group" uses group colours.

label_vjust

Vertical justification of labels at their offset (0.2 is close to baseline alignment).

label_colour

Label colour.

missing_text

Text for missing x values on a categorical y axis.

missing_size

Its size.

separators

Draw lines between rows of different groups (categorical y).

x_limits, y_limits, x_breaks, y_breaks, x_nbins, y_nbins

Axes.

log_y

Logarithmic y axis (values at or below zero are not drawn).

x_label, y_label

Axis titles.

grid

"y", "x", "both" or "none".

tick_size

Tick label size, or c(x, y).

title_size

Axis title size, or c(x, y).

stats

Optional one-row data frame for note (default: first row of data).

note

Optional template (see FormatTemplate()) written at note_xy (panel fractions), for example a correlation coefficient.

note_xy, note_hjust, note_vjust, note_size, note_colour

Note placement and style.

reference

Optional data frame of vertical reference lines (for example the value chosen in each analysis), one per row.

reference_x

Column of reference with the x positions.

reference_group

Optional column of reference whose values take their colour from group_colours.

reference_linewidth, reference_linetype

Reference line width (points) and dash pattern.

ties

Draw units at the same position side by side (tie_dodge x units apart) and write their labels once, joined by commas, right of the group at tie_label_dx[1] + tie_label_dx[2] * n x units.

tie_dodge, tie_label_dx, tie_label_size, tie_label_colour

Layout and style of tied units and their labels.

box_mm

Size of the data area c(width, height) in millimetres, passed by RenderFigure(); used by "auto" tick intervals (see NiceBreaks()).

style

A ManuscriptStyle() object.

Value

A 'ggplot2' object.

Examples

d <- data.frame(id = paste0("u", 1:5), group = c("A", "A", "B", "B", "B"),
                x = c(0.1, 0.4, 0.2, 0.8, 0.5), y = c(1, 3, 2, 5, 4))
PlotScatterGroups(d, id = "id", label = "id", group_colours = c(A = "#009E73", B = "#0072B2"))
